panels.title: Stochastic one-second pilot — isolated $25 virtual account
Stochastic one-second pilot: rules and assumptions

options.content:
**1-second completed bars; long-only SOL/cash.**

```text
K = SMA10 of stochastic over the trailing 900 seconds; D = SMA30 of K.
Trend = EMA300 > EMA1200 (one-second closes). Flat range K = 50.
IF flat AND 60-second cooldown complete: buy after K crosses above D,
with K >= 60 and positive trend sustained for 3 seconds.
IF long: sell after K < D and K <= 40 for 3 seconds.
ELSE hold. Account and capacity gates override entries.
```

Public Binance SOLUSDT proxy; signal delayed one second before the next close supplies the simulated FOK limit. This is not a True Markets executable quote. New fills pay **20 bp (0.20%) per side, fee-only scenario**; the SOL sell fee has settlement evidence, buy symmetry is assumed. No fixed slippage charge is added. Original $25 funding, prior cash and historical 30 bp fills are preserved. Account lifetime panels include the earlier five-minute strategy; the pilot-only panels below start at the immutable cutover baseline. No top-ups.

**Bounded engineering run:** 30 minutes of entries, up to 5 further minutes for exit, 2400 frames including retries, at most 40 additional fills plus exit reserve, and existing $10 drawdown / 240 lifetime-order stops. Missing data can prevent exit. Only one cluster. This pilot does not establish alpha or approve live trading.

panels.title: Bar close to fill (mean)
panels.description: Legacy five-minute run only; intentionally unavailable for the one-second variant until an exact order-to-signal timestamp join exists. Includes the data fetch, the decision, authorization, any retry after a stale-risk refusal, and the simulated venue.

panels.title: SOL price with confirmed entries / exits
panels.description: Markers are confirmed simulated fills, never raw signals. Their chart time has scrape/bucket resolution; exact confirmation times are retained in the ledger. Missed historical times are unknown, not invented. Zoom in to inspect close entries/exits.

panels.title: Decision samples (range estimate)
panels.description: Prometheus increase extrapolates between scrapes and handles process counter resets; this is an estimated count, not an exact event ledger.

panels.title: Mean tick to decision
panels.description: Payload delivered to Python through receipt of the committed decision at the local C++ submitter. Includes indicators, durable journal and two Raft commits. Excludes HTTP fetch, authorization and fills. Same-host wall clock; clock steps can distort durations.

panels.title: p99 estimate (100+ samples)
panels.description: Bucket interpolation, not an exact observed percentile. Hidden below an estimated 100 samples. Five-minute decisions do not characterize high-load tail latency.

panels.title: Tick to decision: mean by component (30m)
panels.description: edge: feature/journal work and IPC; source_commit and decision_commit: request to committed reply, including networking, scheduling, quorum and durable storage. Not pure kernel execution time.

panels.description: Stops are independent for each account. Loss/capacity/duration stops persist across restart.

panels.title: Venue vs kernel
panels.description: 1 = at a comparable cut the paper venue's base differed from the kernel's position (zero-lot tolerance). New risk stays stopped until a restart. Alert: VelocitaGatewayReconciliationMismatch.

panels.title: Compared position (lots)
panels.description: Kernel and venue position at the last comparable cut; frozen at the values of a mismatch.

panels.title: Re-arms (range)
panels.description: Automatic re-arms after a fence (election or state-read gap).

panels.title: Since clean reconciliation
panels.description: Seconds since the venue's book last matched the kernel at a comparable cut. 'unknown' = none since the gateway started (a cut is comparable only with no order open).

panels.title: Stops by cause (per hour)
panels.description: fence re-arms by itself after the quiet period; every other cause holds new risk until the gateway is restarted (runbook 5.3).

panels.title: Why new risk is stopped now
panels.description: 1 per active cause. awaiting_arm = only the arming check is pending (quiet period, an open order, or a cut not yet comparable). Alert: VelocitaGatewayAwaitingRearm after 10 m.

panels.title: Stochastic gateway: observed effect -> proof -> send -> fill -> committed
Sum of gateway stage means
panels.description: Four gateway-clock stage means. Starts when the gateway first observes a deliverable effect. Excludes tick processing, decision authorization and the wait before gateway observation. Stages may have different sample counts across a window or restart; this sum is not a paired end-to-end latency.

panels.title: Where the time goes (mean ms per order, 5m)
panels.description: Independent gateway-stage means. Their sum is not full tick-to-trade latency. sent_to_fill is the simulated venue.

panels.title: p99 by stage (selected range, 100+ orders)
panels.description: 99th percentile of each stage over the dashboard's time range, from the stage histogram. Shown only for a stage with at least 100 orders in the range. Percentiles do not add.

panels.title: Orders per stage (selected range)
panels.description: How many orders each stage timing is based on. Below 100 the percentile panels stay empty.

panels.title: Stage latency p50 (selected range, 100+ orders)
panels.description: Median per stage. Resolution is limited by the histogram's buckets.

panels.title: Stage latency p99 (selected range, 100+ orders)
panels.description: 99th percentile per stage, from bucket interpolation.

options.content: **The weekly volume-strategy panels below (churn, rotate, dip) have no data:** those strategies are not running. The stochastic strategy's volume, cost and stop figures are in its own section above.

panels.title: Volume strategies: this ISO week against the loss budget
Volume this week
panels.description: Filled notional, buys plus sells. ISO week to date (UTC, from Monday 00:00), from the edge's paper book: fills the kernel's position confirmed, costed at the paper venue's fees.

panels.title: Fees this week
panels.description: Paper venue fees on this week's fills, in US cents. ISO week to date (UTC, from Monday 00:00), from the edge's paper book: fills the kernel's position confirmed, costed at the paper venue's fees.

panels.title: Net P&L this week
panels.description: Realized: each buy's fee at the buy, each sell's price move and fee at the sell. ISO week to date (UTC, from Monday 00:00), from the edge's paper book: fills the kernel's position confirmed, costed at the paper venue's fees.

panels.title: Volume per $ lost
panels.description: Dollars of volume bought with each dollar lost this week: the leaderboard's efficiency. 'unknown' while the week has no loss.

panels.title: Trades per hour (1h)
panels.description: Paper fills per hour over the last hour, from the gateway.

panels.title: Loss budget used
panels.description: This week's realized loss as a share of --weekly-loss-cap-usd (default $12). Above 100 % the edge stops buys (exits only) until Monday 00:00 UTC.

panels.title: Weekly volume: observed vs expected
panels.description: The paper run against the backtest's prediction interval (the edge's --expected-week-volume-usd LOW,HIGH; absent until configured). Observed restarts at 0 each Monday; the gateway line is a rolling 7 days.

panels.title: Weekly loss: observed vs expected and the cap
panels.description: Loss = max(0, -net P&L of the week). Expected: the edge's --expected-week-loss-usd LOW,HIGH.

panels.title: Buys stopped and withheld
panels.description: stopped = 1 while the edge sends exits_only (loss_budget: the week's loss is above the cap; insufficient_balance: flat and the book's cash cannot pay a clip plus fee). withheld = buys the strategy proposed while flat that were never sent.

panels.title: Volume by side (USD per hour, 1h)
panels.description: Filled notional per hour from the gateway's fills.

panels.title: Fees, last 7 days (cents)
panels.description: Venue-reported paper fees over a rolling week, in US cents.

panels.title: Gross P&L this week (before fees)
panels.description: Net P&L plus fees: the realized price-move result of this week's closed round trips, before the paper venue's fees. Positive = the strategy's timing made money before costs. ISO week to date (UTC, from Monday 00:00), from the edge's paper book: fills the kernel's position confirmed, costed at the paper venue's fees.

panels.title: P&L this week: gross, fees, net
panels.description: Net = gross - fees. ISO week to date; all three restart at 0 each Monday 00:00 UTC.
